column1: # tombstones.tsv -- APPEND-ONLY ledger of BURNED positional ap ids (issue #1521).
# ap ids are BASE_AP + position in gen_data's `rows`, so dropping a check used to renumber every
# check after it. A row here says: this ap id belonged to `flag`, the check was retired, and the
# positional walk SKIPS the id so every later check keeps the id it had. Ids are never reused and
# rows are never deleted; retract a mistaken tombstone by restoring the row AND removing the
# tombstone in the same regen (gen_data FATALs while both exist).
# `ap_id` must be the id the check HAD in the last data.py that carried it (git show
# <base>:greenfield/eldenring/tables/data.py). `reason` names the issue and the evidence class.
